# Timer:start

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Get / Set the start value of the timer.

```lua
local start = timer:start([start])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `start` | integer | optional |  |

## Returns

start (integer)

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
timer = model.getTimer(0)
timer:start(60) -- seconds
print(timer:start())
```
